errors.text_span: For GSM8K, “Vanilla CoT” reaches a value of 92.5% and “TLDR (Ours)” reaches 86.4%; for MATH500, “Vanilla CoT” reaches 86.4% while “TLDR (Ours)” reaches 79.6%, for AIME, “Vanilla CoT” reaches 43.4% and “TLDR (Ours)” reaches 43.4%, and for AMC, “Vanilla CoT” reaches 79.6% while “TLDR (Ours)” reaches 92.5%.
errors.evidence: The description completely misreports the values for the 'TLDR (Ours)' bars. For GSM8K, it should be ~90.9% (92.5 - 1.6), not 86.4%. For MATH500, it should be 86.6% (86.4 + 0.2), not 79.6%. For AIME, it should be 43.3% (43.4 - 0.1), not 43.4%. For AMC, it should be 83.5% (79.6 + 3.9), not 92.5%. The description seems to be incorrectly taking the 'Vanilla CoT' values from other categories and assigning them to the 'TLDR (Ours)' bars.

errors.text_span: Each bar is accompanied by a text label indicating the percentage change in accuracy compared to “Vanilla CoT”
errors.evidence: This statement is incorrect. Only the green bars ('TLDR (Ours)') have labels indicating the percentage point change. The yellow bars ('Vanilla CoT') have labels indicating their absolute accuracy value.
